use default

reciprocal_factorials() -> Pipe[decimal] is
    let term mut = 1m
    let n mut = 1

    do
        yield term
        term = term / cast(n)
        n = n + 1
    od
si

let e = reciprocal_factorials()
    |> take(30)
    |> reduce(0m, (sum, term) => sum + term)

write_line("e = {e}")
